ChatGPT MCP gating (PLATFORM REALITY, not legislation). MCP is real but gated: Developer Mode plus paid plan, remote HTTPS endpoints only, per-action confirmation. Old 2023 plugins are deprecated. Availability varies by plan, region, workspace, and role.

Muse availability and connector review (PLATFORM REALITY, not legislation). Muse is US-only with no confirmed UK date. Connectors need functional, security, and legal review. Custom connectors are unreviewed. Never promise directory placement.

FCA authorisation for account and payment initiation. Account-information and payment-initiation services are regulated activities. Use an appropriately authorised provider; never collect customer banking credentials.
Boarding/daycare licensing + welfare duty. Local-authority licence required; 5-star rating criteria as ops checklist; incident protocol in place.
CDM principal-contractor + contractor duties. Principal contractor plans, manages, and monitors; contractors SKET-check appointees; domestic-client duties default to the contractor in control.
Construction Industry Scheme deductions. Verify subcontractors with HMRC; deduct 20% registered / 30% unregistered; file CIS300 monthly.
COSHH + Work at Height for cleaning trades. COSHH assessments for bleach, solvents, and detergents; risk assessment and controls for ladder and window work; competent persons only.

Clinical judgment stays with registered clinicians; duty of candour on harm. Agent handles admin and navigation only; every clinical decision traceable to a registered clinician; open disclosure on harm.

Funeral price transparency + inducement ban. Standardised Price List plus Attended/Unattended prices; ownership disclosure; ban on hospital/hospice/care-home inducements and coroner/police solicitation. No licensing regime in England/Wales yet.
Consumer rights + distance selling + trading allowance. Goods must be fit for purpose; 14-day distance-returns information; register with HMRC past £1,000 trading income.
Chemical safety + patch-test records in hair/beauty. COSHH assessments for tints and bleach; patch test plus record before colour services.
Data protection + card-data handling. Lawful basis and minimisation for client data and photos; never store raw PANs; secrets as references, never values.
Electrical competence + Part P + PRS 5-yearly EICRs. Competent persons only; notifiable domestic work via registered scheme or building control; private rentals need valid 5-year EICR.
F-Gas qualification requirement. Certificate required for F-gas work on stationary refrigeration, air conditioning, heat pumps, and refrigerated trucks/trailers.

Gas competence + Gas Safe Register membership. No gas work unless competent; no employee/self-employed gas work unless in HSE-approved class (Gas Safe Register). Employers must ensure and monitor competence.
Hire-and-reward insurance + mileage rules. Hire-and-reward cover required (standard SDP excludes paid work); log all miles for AMAP (55p/mile to 10k from Apr 2026).

CQC fundamental standards + fit and proper persons. Reg 19: robust recruitment, relevant checks, ongoing fitness monitoring; Regs 9-20A: person-centred care, consent, safe care, safeguarding, staffing, governance, duty of candour

LOLER inspections + chainsaw competence. 6-monthly thorough examination for climbing kit used for lifting persons; documented chainsaw training (NPTC route) for insurance and council work. No statutory 'chainsaw licence' exists.
AML supervision for accountancy service providers. Register with HMRC or a professional-body supervisor unless exempt (under £30k turnover, under 5% accountancy, supervised review).

MTD for Income Tax: digital records + quarterly updates. Digital records plus quarterly updates via compatible software: £50k+ from Apr 2026, £30k+ from Apr 2027, £20k+ from Apr 2028. Points accrue per missed deadline.
Natasha's Law: PPDS allergen labelling. Name plus full ingredients with 14 allergens emphasised, on package or label.
Fire safety + MOT integrity + food hygiene baselines. Fire risk assessment with competent persons; honest MOT testing per DVSA standards; FHRS hygiene discipline.

Regulated activity with adults + DBS barred-list checks. Enhanced DBS + Adults' Barred List for personal care, healthcare under direction/supervision, social work, day-to-day management of those doing it; Regulated Activity Providers have a legal duty to refer
Regulated activity with children (teaching/training unsupervised). Enhanced DBS + Children's Barred List for unsupervised teaching/training of under-18s.

Fair tips: 100% pass-through + written policy + tronc rules. Allocate 100% of qualifying tips fairly with no deductions; written policy where non-occasional; independent tronc only if genuinely independent.

Tree Preservation Orders + conservation-area controls. Check TPO/register status before quoting; correct notice or application per route; diary the statutory response window per case. Never hardcode one clock.

VMR batch/prescriber/5yr retention + Schedule 2 CD register + PSS. Every dispense logged with batch and prescriber, 5-year retention; controlled-drug running balances with witnesses; PSS evidence pack always ready.

PECR consent and soft opt-in for electronic marketing. Sole traders and some partnerships are individual subscribers: unsolicited electronic marketing generally needs consent unless a valid soft opt-in applies. Screen live calls against TPS/CTPS.
Money moves on human approval (DESIGN RULE, not legislation). Money moves only on human-issued, parameter-bound, single-use, expiring capability. Explicitly NOT statute.

Social account creation is human-only (PLATFORM RULE, not legislation). Social account creation is human-only. The agent maps, guides, verifies, and connects — it never creates accounts. Explicitly NOT law.
Secrets handling (DESIGN RULE, not legislation). No secrets in prompts, logs, handovers, or backups metadata. Secrets live in customer-owned vaults or OS keychains, referenced never valued.
Tenant isolation (DESIGN RULE, not legislation). Every row acted on must belong to the expected customer. Cross-tenant reads or writes fail closed.
Corporation Tax on company profits. Corporation Tax on company profits; digital records for year end; main rate applies above thresholds with marginal relief below.
PAYE, NICs, pensions, and wage floors for employers. Operate PAYE, deduct Income Tax and Class 1 NICs, auto-enrol eligible staff into pensions. National Minimum/Living Wage floors apply.
VAT registration at £90,000 rolling turnover. Register at £90,000 taxable turnover over a rolling 12 months. MTD for VAT returns. Non-established UK suppliers can have different obligations.

Call-recording notification and lawful basis (DESIGN GUIDANCE, not legislation). Inform all parties that calls are recorded; state the purpose; store securely with retention limits. Confirm the exact position with legal advice before deploying.
